title: Critique: the approach oscillates between a modest and an ambitious version

statements.text: A modest higher-order theory explains one sense of the word conscious and allows phenomenal consciousness without higher-order states. The ambitious version claims to explain what it is like. Block holds that an unnoticed shift between the two gives the approach its appeal.

sources.quote: I believe that it is an unnoticed oscillation between the relatively innocuous modest version and the controversial ambitious version that fuels the fire of the higher order approach.
